proposals.rationale: DeviceStreams now holds two warm streams per device: warm_load (H2D) + warm_store (D2H), split for PCIe overlap (lib.rs:335-345); device_streams_for creates both plus pipeline pair (:371-378). Spec said 'single warm CUDA stream'.
proposals.before: pre-allocate a single warm CUDA stream ... used ... for memcpy_h2d_async ... the per-device warm stream from DEVICE_STREAMS.
proposals.after: per-device warm_load (H2D) + warm_store (D2H) streams split for PCIe bidirectional overlap; H2D via memcpy_batch_async on warm_load; warm_stream AtomicU64 fallback retained.

proposals.rationale: DeviceStreams { warm_load, warm_store, pipe: [u64;2] } (lib.rs:339-345): two warm streams + pipeline pair per device.
proposals.before: one warm stream plus one pipeline stream pair per device.
proposals.after: two warm streams (warm_load for H2D and warm_store for D2H, FR-037) plus one pipeline stream pair per device.

proposals.rationale: Both warm directions now use batched memcpy_batch_async (cuMemcpyBatchAsync): H2D scatter on warm_load (lib.rs:1116-1127); D2H gather in copy_gpu_to_memory_async on warm_store (lib.rs:2998-3009). memcpy_h2d_async is mock-only now (lib.rs:4193,4260,5244).
proposals.before: warm-path H2D via memcpy_h2d_async; copy_gpu_to_memory_async issues asynchronous GPU->host DMA on the supplied stream.
proposals.after: batched memcpy_batch_async scatter (H2D on warm_load) / gather (D2H on warm_store).

proposals.rationale: gRPC removed; shm-queue sole control transport. promote_to_memory_tier API unchanged; only the invoking transport changed.
proposals.before: The gRPC handler spawns this as a detached background task when BatchTouchRequest.promote = true.
proposals.after: The shm-queue control transport (the sole control transport since gRPC was removed) spawns this as a detached background task when a batch-touch request sets promote = true.

proposals.rationale: Eviction-event channel unchanged; named example consumer (gRPC TakeEvents) removed. shm-queue transport is now the consumer.
proposals.before: external consumers (e.g., gRPC TakeEvents stream) to observe cache evictions without polling.
proposals.after: external consumers (e.g., the shm-queue TakeEvents stream) to observe cache evictions without polling.

proposals.rationale: IDispatcher::tier_event_stats() -> TierEventStats (idispatcher.rs:564; struct :189-210) implemented via lock-free TierEventCounters (lib.rs:111-160, tier_counters field :317, trait impl :3390); no requirement covered it. Four monotonic u64 counters: promotions_to_memory, promotions_to_gpu, evictions_from_memory, evictions_from_ssd. Always-on; non-tiering variants return zeros.
proposals.after: New FR-058 (tier-event counters) + SC-017 (zero at startup, monotonic, delta = tier events in window; non-tiering variant returns zeros).
